born.why: This code improves safety by applying exponential decay to memory (recent experiences matter more) and strict trait matching to generalize danger, prioritizing starvation survival while using tasting only when hunger outweighs the risk of uncertainty.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when hunger is critical, avoids known poisonous species using the diary, and uses a "taste" strategy for novel fruits only when hunger is sufficiently high to justify the risk, ensuring Fagi learns safely over time.

The code prioritizes avoiding known poisons above all, uses "tasting" on sweet-smelling unknown fruits to gather data without high risk when not starving, and leverages smell heuristics to make safer guesses about unknown species, ensuring longevity by minimizing accidental poisoning while still foraging efficiently.

The code improves safety by maintaining species-specific history to distinguish between consistently safe, consistently poisonous, and ambiguous fruits, using a confidence threshold to trust safe fruits more over time, while defaulting to tasting unknown sweet-smelling fruits to build knowledge safely.

The code prioritizes carrying known-safe fruits to the pantry, uses tasting for unknown sweet fruits when not starving to gather data with minimal risk, and strictly avoids known poisonous species unless starvation forces an eat decision.

The code prioritizes safety by blocking consumption of fruits sharing traits with previously poisoned items, uses verified safe traits to bypass risk for high-value carrying, and balances starvation urgency against cautious learning via tasting.

This code prioritizes exact species (key) matches for safety decisions to avoid cross-contamination errors, uses a dynamic hunger-based threshold for tasting to balance data gathering against risk, and distinguishes between carrying safe food and tasting uncertain food.
